overview: The red LOS01024T1 Mini-B Brushless makes sense for an aspiring mini racer who has a suitable circuit or an organized class nearby. At 272mm long it is substantially larger than a Micro-B, and the brushless system changes how much usable space matters. Greg Vogel’s RC Driver coverage takes this version to RC Madness and discusses revisions beyond the motor change.
verdict: Buy the brushless Mini-B for a class and a course you can use

sections.heading: A miniature race buggy still needs a real place to run.
paragraphs: The red LOS01024T1 Mini-B Brushless makes sense for an aspiring mini racer who has a suitable circuit or an organized class nearby. At 272mm long it is substantially larger than a Micro-B, and the brushless system changes how much usable space matters. Greg Vogel’s RC Driver coverage takes this version to RC Madness and discusses revisions beyond the motor change. That outside track visit is useful context, but our buying recommendation does not claim its lap times or driving feel as our own.

The exact purchase in this guide is Losi Mini-B Brushless LOS01024T1, Red · complete brushless buggy. Its 1/16 scale, 2WD drivetrain and brushless power system identify a complete assembled vehicle. That combination should be matched to aspiring mini buggy racer before a promotional feature becomes the reason to order. Check the venue and permitted class early; a race or drift label does not establish eligibility. The dated manufacturer documentation supplies the hardware facts, the Amazon API supplies listing identity, and outside coverage remains the work of its named author. Our preference is an editorial interpretation of those sources. It does not turn the published claims into personal driving experience or measured results.

sections.heading: The battery is included; the USB power adapter is still a check.
paragraphs: The factory package includes an 810mAh Smart G2 2S battery and Smart USB-C charger. Losi lists a QC 2.0/3.0 USB adapter rated at least 18W in its completion requirements. This is why the word RTR cannot replace a startup basket. A buyer with a suitable adapter may need no new purchase there; someone relying on an unspecified older USB supply should check it before the buggy arrives. Four AA transmitter cells are also listed in the box.

For Mini-B Brushless, the stated drive-power arrangement is Spektrum Smart G2 810mAh 2S LiPo · included, and the radio package is Spektrum SLT2 transmitter; SR315 receiver. Required completion is explicit: QC 2.0/3.0 USB power adapter rated 18W or more. Make a physical inventory before buying additional equipment. The finished vehicle already coordinates the body, drivetrain and installed controls, but correct operation still requires the model's startup and charging procedure. Check the pack leads and connectors without pulling on their wires, inspect steering travel before running, and confirm the transmitter power arrangement against the actual holder. If an item differs from the exact LOS01024T1 list, resolve that with the seller or manufacturer while the purchase details are available. A package discrepancy should not be covered up by ordering a replacement and assuming every similarly named RTR comes with the same components.

sections.heading: The 6000Kv system is a complete motor-and-controller decision.
paragraphs: Spektrum Firma combines the brushless motor and ESC in one unit, paired with a separate SR315 receiver. That layout differs from the brushed Micro-B’s combined radio/controller arrangement. It gives the current Mini-B a clearly identified factory electronic package and avoids treating an owner-installed conversion as the reviewed car. The transmission uses metal gears and a bevel differential. Start with the prescribed 2S equipment and gearing before deciding the factory system needs replacement.

The documented Spektrum Firma 6000 Kv 2-in-1 brushless motor/ESC is the power equipment evaluated for Mini-B Brushless. With rear-wheel drive, available grip and trigger input need to work together. A harder trigger pull can ask more from the rear tires without improving the front wheels’ ability to turn. Start from the original LOS01024T1 gearing and battery specification. Keep optional electronics purchases separate until the stock configuration reveals a specific requirement worth changing.

sections.heading: A simple radio can still support useful training.
paragraphs: The SLT2 includes reduced throttle settings so a new mini racer can learn the circuit with less available output. The SR315 receiver also creates a different radio-upgrade path from an integrated ESC/receiver, but compatibility needs checking against the exact transmitter and receiver protocols. RC Driver’s article incorrectly labels the scale 1:18; the official product and manual identify 1/16. That discrepancy does not change the car you should order or justify copying an older brushed Mini-B control description.

The Mini-B Brushless control system is listed as Spektrum SLT2 transmitter; SR315 receiver. Treat the manual as the reference for binding, reversing, neutral settings and any assistance function supplied with this exact package. Radio frequency alone does not establish compatibility with a replacement transmitter or receiver. Check steering trim on the surface you intend to use, then verify response in both directions before a demanding session. For organized use, ask whether assistance is allowed and whether battery or tire rules apply; the factory radio cannot answer the venue’s rules for you. If the car behaves incorrectly, distinguish a setting issue from physical binding. A new electronic part is a poor first response when the existing linkage is prevented from moving freely.

sections.heading: The revisions are reasons to buy the exact generation.
paragraphs: Losi describes a thicker front bulkhead, revised servo saver, shock cartridge spacers and a transmission case that accepts sway bars. Those details show why the current brushless RTR should be identified by its SKU rather than described as any Mini-B with a faster motor. Its mid-motor layout and threaded oil shocks offer a meaningful setup project. Accepting an optional sway bar is not the same as supplying one, so a buyer should keep factory contents and future tuning purchases separate.

The published construction for Mini-B Brushless is 1.5mm 6061-t 6 aluminum; 7mm oil shocks. Those details describe what an owner can inspect and maintain; they do not provide a measured suspension or steering score. Use the original mounting positions as a reference and check movement before changing springs, shock positions or link lengths. Its listed wheelbase is 191 mm, which makes exact replacement compatibility more useful than a generic Losi parts search. Confirm tire clearance through steering travel and suspension movement with the body installed. Change one mechanical setting at a time, record the new position and return to the baseline if the result becomes confusing. A good tuning process should explain the change you are seeking, rather than replace several components at once and leave you unable to identify which one helped.

sections.heading: The stock treads are a starting point for a chosen surface.
paragraphs: Wide Body Rib front tires and Big Shot rears are the published factory combination. They are part of the mini-buggy format, not a guarantee of equal grip on dirt and carpet. If a local club has a control tire or a motor restriction, those requirements should guide the purchase before optional parts. At home, choose a repeatable smooth circuit and sensible jump transitions. The mini size makes a driveway track practical, but uneven grass remains a very different environment.

The Mini-B Brushless tire package is Wide Body Rib front; Big Shot rear. Its intended terrain listing is indoor and on-road and off-road. Begin on a surface that lets you observe a consistent response, then adjust the course rather than immediately blaming the tire. Allow adequate space for braking and a clear run-out, particularly when the factory power system can quickly consume the available straight. The published dimensions are 272 × 178 × 102 mm. They help plan the space and transport requirements, but they do not establish measured grip, rollover angle or jump behavior.

sections.heading: The aluminum chassis does not replace regular inspection.
paragraphs: The foundation is a 1.5mm 6061-T6 aluminum plate with a screened polycarbonate body. The chassis construction is a fact; surviving a particular impact is not established by the material name. Use the exploded view to understand steering, suspension and transmission access. The stock SX108 metal-gear servo should be checked for free movement and sensible travel before concluding a stronger unit is required. Correcting a mechanical bind should come before adding torque.

The reviewed Red · complete brushless buggy Mini-B Brushless is supplied as a complete vehicle with a finished body, rather than a replacement shell or bare platform. The official photographs show the exact package and relevant details; their staging is not our test record. Learn how the shell is secured before forcing access to the battery area, and protect any leads that cross between body and chassis. After running, inspect wheel attachment, steering movement and dirt accumulation, then consult the LOS01024T1 drawing for part identification. A correct replacement number can be more useful than an expensive upgrade when the original component simply needs servicing. Body material, metal gears or aluminum construction describe the hardware, but none is treated here as evidence of crash resistance or a long-term reliability rating without physical testing.

sections.heading: The Mini-T trades the buggy format for a shorter truck.
paragraphs: The red LOS-1056T1 Mini-T 2.0 Brushless is the closest complete Losi alternative here. It also supplies an 810mAh Smart G2 2S package and a Spektrum 6000Kv system, but its 160mm wheelbase differs from the Mini-B’s 191mm. Choose according to the class people actually run and the body and wheel format you want. Similar electronics do not prove identical driving behavior. A micro buggy becomes the better alternative only if your available circuit is much smaller.

Losi Mini-T 2.0 Brushless LOS-1056T1 is the complete alternative used in the comparison with Mini-B Brushless. It is a 1/18 2WD brushless vehicle, with Spektrum Smart G2 810mAh 2S LiPo · included. Its required completion is qc 2.0/3.0 usb power adapter rated 18w or more. Those package differences are concrete enough to guide a shortlist without inventing a common track or obstacle test. First decide whether the comparison should keep the same scale and format, or whether your driving area points toward a different kind of vehicle. If a club is involved, local model knowledge and rules should be part of that decision. We link the alternative manufacturer's documentation so a buyer can verify its equipment independently. Similar product names, brand reputation and a lower car-only figure are not substitutes for a suitable completed purchase.
